span.p:
Worker
ek khabar 5 baar
-> dekha hua URL Bloom filter se pakdo
alag URL pe wahi khabar title ke hash / SimHash se pakdo
(hash + SimHash)
wahi URL dobara -> koi bit 0 = pakka naya (Bloom filter)
kai worker -> ek saanjha Bloom (Redis)
wins vs won -> 90% same = duplicate
